title: Refinement invariance of face-cocone evaluations
statement: Use simplicial categories of [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting] and the subset-poset simplex model of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. Let $V$ be a finite nonempty linearly ordered set, and let $\mathcal F$ be a family of nonempty subsets of $V$ containing every singleton and closed under taking nonempty subsets. For $F\in\mathcal F$, write $\Delta^F$ for the ordered simplex on $F$. Let $D$ be a small simplicial category and let $f_F:\mathfrak C[\Delta^F]\to D$ be enriched functors strictly compatible under all inclusions $F\subseteq G$ in $\mathcal F$. Write $d_v=f_{\{v\}}(v)$. For $i<j$ in $V$, let $S=(S_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq S_q)$ be a chain of subsets of $[i,j]$ containing $i,j$, with $q\geq0$. A splitting set $R=\{i=a_0<\cdots<a_r=j\}\subseteq S_0$ is admissible if $T_b=S_q\cap[a_{b-1},a_b]\in\mathcal F$ for every $b$. Define $E_R(S)\in D(d_i,d_j)_q$ as the ordered composite of $f_{T_b}$ applied to the restricted flags $(S_t\cap[a_{b-1},a_b])_{t=0}^q$. If $R\subseteq R'\subseteq S_0$ contains the endpoints and $R$ is admissible, then $R'$ is admissible and $E_{R'}(S)=E_R(S)$. Consequently any two admissible splitting sets give the same value; in particular this value equals the value for the canonical splitting set $S_0$.
